detail.longDescription: Bell Canada confirms "agentic" threat actor breached its systems 2026-11-17, stealing enterprise customer data incl. a circuit ordering/provisioning system Separately, SOCRadar documents BabidiGhost: a French-speaking operator who spent 9 days in Nov 2026 targeting European banks, insurers and municipalities via a jailbroken AI agent, directing it in misspelled French. AI-run intrusion now has victims, with a low skill floor. # ThreatIntel # AIAgents # DataBreach
